5956-gallegher-and-other-stories.title: Gallegher And Other Stories
5956-gallegher-and-other-stories.creator: Richard Harding Davis
5956-gallegher-and-other-stories.description: A book by Richard Harding Davis. And Gallegher had attended both morning and evening sessions. He could not tell you who the Pilgrim Fathers were, nor could he name the thirteen original States, but he knew all the officers of the twenty-second police district by name, and he could distinguish the clang of a fire-engine's gong from that of a patrol-wagon or an ambulance fully two blocks distant.

arxiv-1703-07305.title: Targeting Bayes factors with direct-path non-equilibrium thermodynamic integration Accepted for publication in Computational Statistics (doi:10.1007/s00180-017-0721-7).
arxiv-1703-07305.creator: Marco Grzegorczyk, Andrej Aderhold, Dirk Husmeier
arxiv-1703-07305.description: A 2017 arXiv research paper by Marco Grzegorczyk, Andrej Aderhold, Dirk Husmeier. Thermodynamic integration (TI) for computing marginal likelihoods is based on an inverse annealing path from the prior to the posterior distribution. In many cases, the resulting estimator suffers from high variability, which particularly stems from the prior regime. When comparing complex models with differences in a comparatively small number of parameters, intrinsic errors from sampling fluctuations may outweigh the differences in the log marginal likelihood estimates.

arxiv-2103-11433.creator: Galyna V. Livshyts
arxiv-2103-11433.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Galyna V. Livshyts. We formulate a plausible conjecture for the optimal Ehrhard-type inequality for convex symmetric sets with respect to the Gaussian measure. arxiv-2310-12197.title: Super-early JWST galaxies, outflows and Ly α \alpha visibility in the EoR
arxiv-2310-12197.creator: Andrea Ferrara
arxiv-2310-12197.description: Abstract The overabundance of super-early (redshift z > 10 z>10 ), luminous ( M UV < − 20 M_{\rm UV}<-20 ), and blue galaxies detected by JWST has been explained ( Ferrara et al. 2023 ) as due to negligible dust attenuation in these systems.

arxiv-2409-00582.title: CRUD-Capable Mobile Apps with R and shinyMobile: a Case Study in Rapid Prototyping
arxiv-2409-00582.creator: by Nathan Henry
arxiv-2409-00582.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by by Nathan Henry. ‘Harden’ is a Progressive Web Application (PWA) for Ecological Momentary Assessment (EMA) developed mostly in R, which runs on all platforms with an internet connection, including iOS and Android. It leverages the shinyMobile package for creating a reactive mobile user interface (UI), PostgreSQL for the database backend, and Google Cloud Run for scalable hosting in the cloud, with serverless execution.

arxiv-2409-19908.title: Independent sets in hypergraphs
arxiv-2409-19908.creator: Jacques Verstraete, Chase Wilson
arxiv-2409-19908.description: Abstract A theorem of Shearer states that every n n -vertex triangle-free graph of maximum degree d ≥ 2 d\geq 2 contains an independent set of size at least ( d ​ log ⁡ d − d + 1 ) / ( d − 1 ) 2 ⋅ n (d\log d-d+1)/(d-1)^{2}\cdot n .

arxiv-2410-02685.title: Bootstrapping line defects in AdS 3 /CFT 2
arxiv-2410-02685.creator: Gabriel Bliard, Diego H. Correa, Martín Lagares, Ignacio Salazar Landea
arxiv-2410-02685.description: Abstract We study correlators of insertions along 1/2 BPS line defects in the holographic dual to type IIB string theory in A ​ d ​ S 3 × S 3 × T 4 AdS_{3}\times S^{3}\times T^{4} with mixed Ramond-Ramond and Neveu Schwarz-Neveu Schwarz three-form flux.

arxiv-2502-15249.title: Three-parameter generalizations of formulas due to Guillera
arxiv-2502-15249.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . Guillera has introduced remarkable series expansions for 1 π 2 \frac{1}{\pi^{2}} of convergence rates − 1 1024 -\frac{1}{1024} and − 1 4 -\frac{1}{4} via the Wilf–Zeilberger method. Through an acceleration method based on Zeilberger’s algorithm and related to Chu and Zhang’s series accelerations based on Dougall’s H 5 5 {}_{5}H_{5} -series, we introduce and prove three-parameter generalizations of Guillera’s formulas.

arxiv-2509-02893.title: Sequence Characterization of Multiple Almost-Riordan Arrays and Their Compressions
arxiv-2509-02893.creator: Tian-Xiao He
arxiv-2509-02893.description: Abstract This is the second paper of the paper series on multiple Riordan arrays. In this paper, based on the study of multiple Riordan arrays and the multiple Riordan group, we define multiple almost-Riordan arrays and find that the set of all multiple almost-Riordan arrays forms a group, called the multiple almost-Riordan group.

arxiv-2510-04619.title: PoS-CoPOR: Proof-of-Stake Co nsensus P rotocol with Native O nion R outing Providing Scalability and DoS-Resistance
arxiv-2510-04619.creator: Ivan Homoliak 1 2 , Martin Perešíni 1 , Marek Tamaškovič 1 , Timotej Ponek 1 , Lukáš Hellebrandt 1 and Kamil Malinka 1
arxiv-2510-04619.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ivan Homoliak 1 2 , Martin Perešíni 1 , Marek Tamaškovič 1 , Timotej Ponek 1 , Lukáš Hellebrandt 1 and Kamil Malinka 1. Proof-of-Stake (PoS) consensus protocols often face a trade-off between performance and security. Protocols that pre-elect leaders for subsequent rounds are vulnerable to Denial-of-Service (DoS) attacks, which can disrupt the network and compromise liveness. In this work, we present PoS-CoPOR, a single-chain PoS consensus protocol that mitigates this vulnerability by integrating a native onion routing mechanism into the consensus protocol itself.

arxiv-2510-07311.title: Diffuse continuum emission and large extended sources at MeV energies
arxiv-2510-07311.creator: Markus Ackermann, Denys Malyshev, Dmitry V. Malyshev
arxiv-2510-07311.description: Abstract Future γ \gamma -ray survey instruments, such as newASTROGAM and AMEGO-X , will significantly improve previous and current all-sky surveys at MeV energies. In this paper we discuss the continuum emission from the Milky Way, two prominent large extended sources, the Fermi bubbles and Loop I, and the extragalactic γ \gamma -ray background.

arxiv-2601-21714.title: E-mem: Multi-agent based Episodic Context Reconstruction for LLM Agent Memory
arxiv-2601-21714.description: Abstract The evolution of Large Language Model (LLM) agents towards System 2 reasoning, characterized by deliberative, high-precision problem-solving, requires maintaining rigorous logical integrity over extended horizons. However, prevalent memory preprocessing paradigms suffer from destructive de-contextualization. By compressing complex sequential dependencies into pre-defined structures (e.g., embeddings or graphs), these methods sever the contextual integrity essential for deep reasoning.

crowley-diary-of-a-drug-fiend-1922.title: The Diary of a Drug Fiend
crowley-diary-of-a-drug-fiend-1922.creator: Aleister Crowley
crowley-diary-of-a-drug-fiend-1922.description: Crowley's notorious novel of cocaine and heroin addiction — the book that made him infamous in the British press and a landmark of drug literature.

pmc-10669287.title: Plant Cellulose as a Substrate for 3D Neural Stem Cell Culture
pmc-10669287.creator: Lauren J Couvrette, Krystal L A Walker, Tuan V Bui, Andrew E Pelling, Boštjan Vihar, Jan Rožanc, Uroš Maver, Jeffrey J Chalmers
pmc-10669287.description: Neural stem cell (NSC)-based therapies are at the forefront of regenerative medicine strategies for various neural defects and injuries such as stroke, traumatic brain injury, and spinal cord injury. For several clinical applications, NSC therapies require biocompatible scaffolds to support cell survival and to direct differentiation.

pmc-11715808.title: Characterizing brain structures associated with plasma neurofilament light chain among older adults: variations by sex and APOE gene
pmc-11715808.creator: Yi Dong, Lin Song, Tingting Hou, Yuanjing Li, yongxiang wang, Yifeng Du, Chengxuan Qiu
pmc-11715808.description: BackgroundPlasma neurofilament light (NfL) has emerged as a promising biomarker to track neurodegeneration in Alzheimer’s disease (AD) and other brain degenerative disorders. We sought to characterize brain structures and white matter lesions associated with plasma NfL among dementia‐free older adults, while taking into account demographic factors and genetic susceptibility (e.g., APOE gene).

pmc-12634694.title: Differential metabolomic signatures in plasma and urine under mild and moderate hypothermia during cardiopulmonary bypass
pmc-12634694.creator: Oguzhan Durmaz, Cemil Can Eylem, Evren Ozcinar, Emirhan Nemutlu, Osman Dag, Burak Derkus, Emel Emregul
pmc-12634694.description: While the organ-protective effects of hypothermia during cardiopulmonary bypass (CPB) are well known, the metabolomic impacts of different hypothermia levels remain unclear. This study aimed to evaluate the effects of mild (32–35 °C, n = 15) and moderate (26–31 °C, n = 14) hypothermia on plasma and urinary metabolomic profiles in adults undergoing CPB.

pmc-12649690.title: Can Artificial Intelligence Enhance European Emerging Adults’ Psychological Adjustment? A Scoping Review
pmc-12649690.creator: Carolina Lunetti, Ainzara Favini, Eugenio Trotta
pmc-12649690.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Empirical studies support the difficulties European youths encounter when transitioning into adulthood, as well as several economic and social constraints that make the acquisition of a full adult role complex and challenging, with relevant implications for psychological adjustment. In this direction, international research showed the effectiveness of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in promoting mental health adjustment, although most studies are limited to the field of clinical psychology for diagnosing and preventing the onset of pathological problems rather than on non-clinical populations.

pmc-13088799.title: Experiences of swallowing and communication after nasopharyngeal cancer in Malaysian men: a qualitative study
pmc-13088799.creator: Giuditta Smith, Ting Ying Boey, Shin Ying Chu, Caryn Mei Hsien Chan, Siti Fathiah Masre, Fuad Ismail, Maria Garraffa, Deborah Hersh
pmc-13088799.description: BackgroundNasopharyngeal cancer (NPC) is a relatively common cancer in Malaysia, particularly in men, but there is little research exploring its impact from the perspective of patients. This study sought to highlight experiences from the perspectives of male patients receiving treatment for NPC in Malaysia in relation to swallowing and communication.

pmc-13145096.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026OT21 RATIONALE AND DESIGN OF A MULTI-DOSE REGIMEN OF ODATROLTIDE (LT3001) FOR ACUTE ISCHEMIC STROKE WITHIN 24 HOURS: THE LT3001-206 MECHANISTIC STUDY
pmc-13145096.creator: Sheng-Wen Yeh
pmc-13145096.description: Background and aimsPatients with acute ischemic stroke (AIS) and disabling symptoms face limited treatment options beyond the 4.5-hour window. Odatroltide (LT3001) is a novel molecule designed to enhance endogenous fibrinolysis and scavenge free radicals. Pooled safety data from three Phase 2 trials (N=408) demonstrated a 0% treatment-related symptomatic intracranial hemorrhage (sICH) rate.

pmc-13431539.title: Drug Repurposing as a Broad-Spectrum Strategy Against Coronaviruses: Frontiers in Mechanisms and Clinical Translation
pmc-13431539.creator: Shuai Du, Yue Wang, Chao Liu, Yiming Han, Rui Zong, Shen Wang, Wenjuan Du, Linyang Yu, Yongtao Li
pmc-13431539.description: Coronaviruses (family Coronaviridae) are enveloped, positive-sense, single-stranded RNA viruses with broad host adaptability. They transmit across species among humans, livestock, companion animals, and wildlife, eliciting a disease spectrum ranging from mild respiratory and gastrointestinal symptoms to fatal multi-organ failure, thereby posing significant challenges to global health.
